metric: A separately created unclipped source-only PDF contains the frozen RGB PNG at the traced affine and page size. The same Poppler renderer resamples both the source and the target page. Both grayscale images use Gaussian radius 1 px. Pearson uses only source gray <247. A single translation is chosen on the whole image among the 25 integer offsets in [-2,2] per axis and fixed for every named ROI. Constant observed content scores zero. The supplementary Pillow bicubic diagnostic uses the same threshold, definition and regions with a different reference resampling kernel.
coordinates: Top-left origin, L,T,R,B. Source-region pixel coordinates and 150 dpi crop-local coordinates are both reported.
